description_en: Replaces the existing authorized users of a cloud computer share with different users
description_zh: 将共享型云电脑的指定授权用户替换为其他指定授权用户
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-user-to-desktop-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-group-id dg-2i8qxpv6t1a030000 --old-end-user-ids alice --new-end-user-ids jack --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyUserToDesktopGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud computer share
parameters.help_zh: 要替换授权用户的共享型云电脑ID
parameters.name: desktop_group_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the end users that you want to remove. You can configure 1 to 500 IDs
parameters.help_zh: 需移除的授权用户ID列表。可配置1~500个
parameters.name: old_end_user_ids

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the end users that you want to add. You can configure 1 to 500 IDs
parameters.help_zh: 需添加的授权用户ID列表。可配置1~500个
parameters.name: new_end_user_ids
